description: Look up a Celo transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in CELO, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use celo_receipt, for emitted events celo_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0xc6a38b860427aa5bd7f65f8a879a7d369e77b3767200c68cde4002014ad50444. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: celo_tx
title: Celo transaction
